QUOTE: Every `threading.c` function and every `mbedtls_threading_*` mutex is gated by `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` (default off, `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). The pthread backend is gated by `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (default off, `mbedtls_config.h:2196`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says both threading macros are off by default in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, with line references, which means a default build defines neither.
